newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P raises CP rating of NZ Receivables to A-1+.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises CP rating of NZ Receivables to A-1+.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had raised the rating of the secured commercial paper of New Zealand Receivables Corp Ltd to A-1+ from A-1.

S&P said the upgrade reflected the credit quality liquidity of the underlying receivables securing the commercial paper, the level of loss reserves established within each pool of receivables, and the external credit and liquidity enhancements provided by appropriately rated entitities.

NZRC is a special purpose company incorporated for the purpose of issuing discounted commercial paper. The proceeds are on-lent to wholly owned subsidiaries which purchase short-term trade receivables from selected New Zealand companies.
